admission.justification: Realized across compiler.py, renderers.py, cli/build_site.py and pyproject.toml and proved by compiler and CLI unit tests; prevents partial VitePress outputs, clobbered .vitepress/ configs, stale generated artifacts and unverified banner or Lean link drift.

applicability: End-to-end static-site compilation across src/rh_pipeline/site/{compiler,renderers}.py, src/rh_pipeline/cli/build_site.py and [project.scripts] in pyproject.toml.
conditions: compile_site validates audit/verification-status.json, dag/dag.json (including upstream_commit parity), Concept Card and explainer gates, Stage 00 overview, asset containment and visual_ref existence in memory before touching out_docs_dir; render_verification_banner emits repo-layout='legacy' when community_verification_notes_sha256 is present and repo-layout='condensed' when None.

Atomic temporary-file staging and managed-directory stale pruning run strictly inside stages/, concepts/, assets/ and public/assets/, never touching .vitepress/, and rh-build-site exits 1 with zero writes on SiteBuildError or SiteDirectiveError.
exclusions: Unexpected OS errors during per-file os.replace propagate uncaught after staging cleanup; argparse usage errors follow standard exit code 2 behavior.
statement: compile_site validates audit/verification-status.json, dag/dag.json, Concept Cards, explainer jargon, stage docs, and SVG assets completely in memory before atomically writing compiled VitePress pages (emitting layout-aware VerificationBanner repo-layout props), preserving .vitepress/ untouched and pruning stale generated files.
title: Fail-closed atomic rh-build-site compilation, rendering and stale pruning
